biotools.summary: MRCE-Net is a deep learning network designed for multi-modal medical image fusion, leveraging complementary strengths from different imaging sources. It utilizes a Multi-Role Collaborative Experts module to achieve comprehensive feature representation for enhanced diagnostic accuracy.
